t: You are on Great St Thomas Apostle, a street in the City of London. The material here is thin, but it does name one resident. Gerrard Roberts, who lived from 1624 to 1703, was a wine cooper, a maker and repairer of wine casks. He worked and lived on this street, at the sign of the Fleur de Lis. Shop signs like that served as addresses before street numbers were common, so that was how customers found him.
